title: Kbd: Kbd sizes (daisyUI)
notes:
Kbd is used to display keyboard shortcuts.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/kbd/+page.md
code:
<kbd class="kbd kbd-xs">Xsmall</kbd>
<kbd class="kbd kbd-sm">Small</kbd>
<kbd class="kbd kbd-md">Medium</kbd>
<kbd class="kbd kbd-lg">Large</kbd>
<kbd class="kbd kbd-xl">Xlarge</kbd>
